summary:
TRALALELO TRALALA JOURNEY is an interactive space-defense game designed to engage players in protecting the Moon from extraterrestrial threats. In this game, players team up with Tralalelo Tralala to fend off waves of invading aliens using strategic targeting and fast-paced shooting mechanics.
We developed this project to make space exploration and lunar protection fun, accessible, and engaging for audiences of all ages. By combining entertaining gameplay with a lunar defense theme, the project highlights the importance of safeguarding Earth's closest celestial neighbor while sparking curiosity about space science and planetary defense. Players experience increasing levels of challenge that test their reflexes and strategy, turning the concept of protecting the Moon into a memorable and interactive adventure.
details: TRALALELO TRALALA JOURNEY is an interactive 2D arcade-style space-defense game where players team up with Tralalelo Tralala to defend the Moon from incoming waves of aliens. Players control movement and aim to shoot down extraterrestrial threats before they reach the lunar surface, scoring points and advancing through escalating difficulty levels. Tools & Software Used We built the game entirely on Scratch, using block-based visual programming to code character controls, projectile physics, enemy spawning, collision detection, and scoring systems. We also used Super Intelligence (AI) during the early ideation and brainstorming phase to refine our game concept and structure our project description.
